about.title: What is electronic billing?
about.body: In the Dominican Republic, Electronic Invoicing Law 32-23 offers tax incentives to encourage early adoption of electronic fiscal receipts (e-CF) during the voluntary period.

categories: Large, micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises
tax.usage: These tax credits can be applied within the same fiscal year against:
tax.itbis: Tax on Transfers of Industrialized Goods and Services (ITBIS)

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.body: Suppliers that invoice the Dominican government using an electronic fiscal receipt (e-CF) may be exempt from the 5% withholding on payments received, subject to applicable rules.

items.question: What is electronic billing?
items.answer: Electronic billing creates and exchanges approved fiscal documents in a digital format.

items.question: How does Codestra support implementation?
items.answer: Codestra reviews the required workflows, integrations, data, testing, and controlled activation steps.

items.question: How is testing handled?
items.answer: The implementation is rehearsed in staging before any approved production activation.

items.question: What is an electronic fiscal receipt (e-CF)?
items.answer: An e-CF is an electronic fiscal document governed by the applicable Dominican tax requirements.

items.question: Where can I request more information?
items.answer: Contact Codestra sales to review your organization, ERP, transaction volume, and implementation requirements.
